## Maintainer-controlled change

Outside contributions are not accepted during the initial OSS preview. This template supports maintainer-controlled repository changes.

## Scope

- Concern:
- Related public-safe Issue, if any:
- Files changed:

## Boundaries

- [ ] GitHub behavior remains read-only.
- [ ] No external LLM API call was added.
- [ ] Fixtures are synthetic and public-safe.
- [ ] No package, tag, release, or production-readiness claim was added.
- [ ] No credential, private repository text, personal data, customer information, local path, or raw packet output is included.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run doctor:json`
- [ ] Demo smoke checks
- [ ] Documentation links checked when documentation changed

## Notes

Passing checks does not itself approve publication, distribution, or release.
